## Bori Metropolis — Borehole Siting Notes (from VES interpretation)

**Note to team:** Two of the filed curve types do not match their layer models. I have given the curve type that the resistivity sequence actually produces and flagged the file entry; the layer models themselves are used as given.

---

**Station:** Kenpoly-convocation-arena
**Curve type:** KHK-type (file says A-type — this is an error; the sequence 1434 < 1879 > 318 < 3488 > 542 is K–H–K, not a continuously rising A curve)
**Aquifer depth:** 25.9 – 50.2 m (layer 4, 3488 ohm-m, 24.3 m thick)
**Recommendation:** Drill to about 55 m and screen the 27–50 m sand; the 318 ohm-m bed at 7.9–25.9 m is clayey and should be cased off, and do not drill past ~52 m into the 542 ohm-m unit.

---

**Station:** Maakoro-street
**Curve type:** KHKH-type (consistent with layer model)
**Aquifer depth:** 24.4 – 124 m (layers 4 and 5, 1109 and 807 ohm-m, combined ~99 m)
**Recommendation:** Best prospect on the site — drill to 115–120 m and screen the thick 49.4–124 m sand, optionally with a second screen at 30–48 m. Stop above the 8895 ohm-m basal unit at 124 m, which is dry/indurated.

---

**Station:** Kenpoly-sec-school-field
**Curve type:** KHK-type (consistent with layer model)
**Aquifer depth:** 27.1 – 59.3 m (layer 4, 3706 ohm-m, 32.2 m thick)
**Recommendation:** Drill to no more than 58 m and screen 30–57 m; terminate above the 178 ohm-m layer below 59.3 m, as penetrating it risks drawing in clay-bound or poorer-quality water.

---

**Station:** Gokana-street
**Curve type:** HAA-type (consistent with layer model)
**Aquifer depth:** 17.4 – 50.9 m (layer 4, 2246 ohm-m, 33.5 m thick)
**Recommendation:** Drill to about 52 m and screen 20–50 m; the 34337 ohm-m basal layer is a dry/compacted unit and is the natural stopping depth. Thin, resistive cover here gives little protection, so grout the annulus to surface.

---

**Station:** BMGS-bori-field
**Curve type:** KQHA-type (consistent with layer model)
**Aquifer depth:** 29.7 – 66.5 m (layer 5, 2950 ohm-m, 36.8 m thick)
**Recommendation:** Drill to about 66 m and screen 35–65 m; case off the 333 ohm-m clay at 20.7–29.7 m, which is the main protective layer and should not be left open.

---

**Station:** Bori-police-station
**Curve type:** HA-type (file says HK-type — this is an error; 150 > 97.1 < 284 < 700 is H followed by A, with no resistivity reversal at depth)
**Aquifer depth:** below 45 m (layer 4, 700 ohm-m, base not resolved by the survey)
**Recommendation:** This is the lowest-resistivity station — treat the 7.4–45 m, 284 ohm-m bed as clayey sand of marginal yield and drill through it to at least 70–80 m, screening only below 45 m. Expect the true aquifer thickness to be unconstrained, so keep a pilot/logging option open and sample water quality before completion.

---

**Curve type:** AA-type (consistent with layer model)
